output.summary: The zero-deviation record is most likely a reporting artifact. The February 2026 bonus penalty (4% per deviation) coincides with reports falling from 14 a month to zero. Meanwhile, independent measures worsened: customer complaints rose from 11 to 31 ppm, QC lot rejections rose, and purchases of replacement components rose 30%. Line 3's 118% plan attainment is explained by roughly 5 borrowed technicians a day. Per technician-hour its output is unchanged, so it is not a transferable model. Training and the tubing switch fit the timing poorly. The hotline allegation of undocumented rework is plausible but not yet verified, and the Plant Manager's knowledge of the lending is unconfirmed. Best actions are to suspend the penalty and run an independent investigation. Do not roll out Line 3 or expose the reporter.
